To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the use of SP techniques in economics and finance has a history of over 30 years; 2) SP has made great contributions to the economics and finance field, but there is still a lot of room for further development; and 3) SP has a bright future in economics and finance, especially with the rapid development of big data.
the SP techniques can be used to extract useful and meaningful information from financial data and that these techniques can be extended to other data sets, such as economic data and marketing data.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing SP methods for finance, economics, marketing, and related fields.
developing signal processing and data science methods and algorithms for economic data and finance applications.
the application of SP concepts, techniques, and tools to finance, economics, marketing and business problems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
SP and data researchers have much to learn from finance and economics and that economics and finance have much to gain from SP and data.
SP for economics and finance will become a new and exciting field of study.
SP for finance, economics, or marketing should not be a new research area but rather a new research perspective.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the goal of this book is to bridge the gap between signal processing, economics and finance, and marketing.
SP can be used for finance and economic data analysis, and economics and business theories can be used for SP applications.
we have successfully developed new SP methods and applications to solve economic and financial problems.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the SP community should be aware of the fundamental theories and applications of economic and business problems, and the economic community should also learn about and leverage the powerful tools and techniques of SP.
the data and SP communities can learn much from the economics and financial communities, and vice versa.
the fundamental economic theories can be formulated in a mathematical form and can be used as a framework for developing new SP methods.
